text.div: Patient Document generated by Health Intersections Patient Health Document Generator

I'm a 14-year-old Yawuru boy from Ardyaloon. I love riding my bike around and fishing with my family. I had a bad accident on my bike last month where I crashed and got really hurt. The doctors say I broke some ribs and hurt my lung and liver. I'm getting better but I'm worried about when I can play footy again and go fishing. My nan says the country will help me heal. I want to get strong again so I can help my family and maybe become a marine biologist to protect our reefs.

Patient's Goals

  • Heal completely from bike accident injuries (in progress)
  • Return to playing Australian Rules Football
  • Continue school and pursue marine biology interests
